default.description: Capability for the app windows. Filesystem access from the webview is limited to: reading files (scope **) because document previews (DocumentPreviewPanel, PDFArtifact) open user-indexed documents that can live anywhere on disk; and writing files without a static scope, so writes only succeed for paths the user picked in a save dialog (the dialog plugin adds the chosen path to the runtime fs scope). Webview data folders stay denied via fs:deny-default.
